title: Increasing Supply for BTO Flats over Next Three Years to Make Up for COVID-19 Construction Delays
what_it_is: Increasing Supply for BTO Flats over Next Three Years to Make Up for COVID-19 Construction Delays

sections.label: BTO flat delays and causes
sections.summary: Circuit breaker disruptions, safe management measures, border controls and supply chain disruptions have delayed projects including HDB BTO flats, inconveniencing flat buyers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Disruptions from the circuit breaker last year, coupled with stringent safe management measures imposed at worksites, the tightening of border controls for workers from South Asia and supply chain disruptions impacting a availability of materials and components, have affected private and public sector projects, including the Housing and Development Board's (HDB's) Build-To-Order (BTO) projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We recognise that the delays to the completion of BTO flats have caused inconvenience to flat buyers and affected many of their life plans.

sections.label: BTO flat supply plans
sections.summary: HDB is on track to launch about 17,000 BTO flats in 2021, and there are no plans to reduce flats launched for 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my earlier reply, HDB is on track to launch about 17,000 BTO flats in 2021, a higher number than the 14,600 in 2019 and 16,800 flats in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor the market situation closely and calibrate the supply of public housing accordingly, to ensure that the flat supply remains responsive to the housing needs of the population.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Going forward, we will continue to maintain a healthy and steady supply of BTO flats annually.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: There are no plans to reduce the number of flats to be launched for 2022, which we will announce when ready.

sections.label: Steady BTO supply and contractor support
sections.summary: Supply will not drop below 17,000 this year, and HDB will work with contractors and agencies to get projects back on track.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Indeed, as I have articulated in this reply and the earlier reply, we will maintain a steady supply of BTO flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will certainly not drop below 17,000 for this year's supply when we go forward.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And we will work closely with our contractors to address the issues that they face, including worker shortages, supply chain disruptions and also, work with fellow agencies to ensure that our construction projects, for existing projects, can get back on track, but without compromising the safety standards of the projects nor the quality of the homes that we deliver.
